description: This file provides helper functions for transform precoding, specifically for validating and determining valid sizes of physical resource blocks (PRBs) based on certain mathematical conditions. It includes functions to check validity, find upper and lower bounds for PRB counts, and defines a static mask for valid PRB numbers.

methods.name: get_valid_nof_prbs
methods.description: Returns a span of booleans indicating valid PRB counts based on a static mask.

methods.name: is_nof_prbs_valid
methods.description: Checks if a given number of PRBs is valid according to the mask.

methods.name: get_nof_prbs_upper_bound
methods.description: Finds the smallest valid PRB count greater than or equal to the input.

methods.name: get_nof_prbs_lower_bound
methods.description: Finds the largest valid PRB count less than or equal to the input.
